page.layout: One column of running text, with Arabic lines set inline within it. In the right margin, beside the first lines, one marginal note. Page number and running head at the top. Gathering mark and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: fieri autem non potest ut perpetuò maneat in igne cum infidelibus, ob illud quòd pronunciatum audivimus, exituri ex igne cuicunque fuerit pondus {*} formiculæ de fide in corde sua. Al Motazalorum [?] doctrina huic ex diametro opposita est referente eodem, scil. Mohammedanum quempiam اذا خرج من غير توبة عن كبيرة ارتكبها [?] استحق الخلود في النار لكن يكون عقابه اخف من عقاب الكفار Cum exierit [è mundo] sine pœnitentia ob grave aliquod quod commiserit peccatum, dignum esse qui in æternum igne crucietur; futuram tamen pœnam ipsius leviorem pœnâ infidelium. Wafeli ejusdem sectæ patris de eo qui gravis peccati reus fuerit, hæc fuit sententia; illum dum in hac vita esset seu medio quodam statu collocandam, ut nec pro fideli, nec prorsus infideli (ut diximus) habendus fit, at اذا خرج عن الدنيا على كبيرة من غير توبة فهو من اهل النار خالدا فيها ان ليس في الاخرة الا الفريقان فريق في الجنة وفريق في السعير لكنه يخفف عليه العذاب ويكون درکة فوق درکة الكفار Cum e-gressu fuerit e mundo peccati gravis reus, non acta pœnitentiâ ingredi eum in ignem perpetuò cruciandum, cum duo sint solùm in altero mundo cœtus, quorum alter in Paradiso, alter in igne fit; cruciatum vero ipsius levio-rem esse, & gradum ipsius supra gradum infidelium. Sunt rursus qui tantùm ab hoc absunt ut quempiam igne in inferno cruciatum iri existiment, ut nec ipsum* sive atomi.

page.notes: Arabic lines transcribed letter by letter from a small, slightly blurred scan; the first word of the second Arabic line and the Arabic transcription generally are uncertain and should be checked against the original. "AlMotazalorum" and "Cum e-gressu" (printed "gressu") are doubtful. The marginal note "* sive atomi." is in the right margin beside the first lines, and its mark "*" stands after "pondus" in the text. The Latin paragraph continues from the previous page and ends mid-sentence on the last line, with the catchword "ipsum" at the foot. Italic passages are read from the scan and may be imprecise.
